identity.statusNote: Distribution moved from the standalone Quixel Bridge/site to the Fab marketplace (fab.com) in October 2024; quixel.com now redirects/links into Fab.

sources.title: Epic has made Megascans free to all - but only until end of 2024
Quixel on Fab: New Megascans and Megaplants

limits.en: A growing selection of Megascans and Megaplants assets is free to use under the Fab Standard License across all engines and tools

keyLimits.en: Paid assets are priced individually on Fab; no fixed subscription plan is published

cautions.en: Megascans was free unlimited through the end of 2024; since 2025 Epic Games began charging for a majority of the library while keeping a growing subset free, so exact current pricing per asset is not published as a fixed plan.

capabilities.en: Library of photoscanned 3D surfaces, props, and plants (Megascans and Megaplants) for use in games, film, and archviz
Assets usable across multiple engines and tools under the Fab Standard License, not limited to Unreal Engine

limitations.en: Distribution now goes exclusively through the Fab marketplace; the original standalone Quixel Bridge plugin/site model was retired
Not all assets are free; individual paid assets exist on Fab and exact current pricing per asset was not accessible from this session

unknowns: The official fab.com/megascans pricing/product page returned HTTP 403 (anti-bot) during this session; current per-asset pricing structure could not be directly verified on the source page.
